explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/500: Turán's construction shows ex_3(n,K_4^3) ≥ (5/9+o(1)) binom(n,3). It uses three near-equal parts, with every rainbow triple and every triple having two vertices in X_i and one in X_{i+1}. The statement is the ε-form, eventually (5/9-ε)·binom(n,3) ≤ cliqueExtremalNumber n 3 4, which is the K_4^3-free extremal number on n vertices. Faithful; solved.
